subtitle: No-smoking zone and smoking area map

info.about1: CleanBreath is a free service that shows no-smoking zones and smoking areas on a map. Green marks no-smoking zones, and orange, red and purple mark smoking areas. In the Apartments tab, you can check whether an apartment complex has designated its hallways, stairs, elevators and underground parking as no-smoking zones.
info.about2: Anyone can suggest a new area on the <register>Suggest an area</register> page. Suggested areas are posted on the <board>board</board>, and once one gets 20 or more “Correct” votes, an administrator reviews it and adds it to the map. You can vote without logging in (a random ID stored in your browser prevents duplicate votes).
info.about3: No-smoking zones are designated under Article 9 of Korea’s National Health Promotion Act. See <statute>No-smoking zone laws</statute> for the rules for each type of facility, and <about>About CleanBreath</about> for who runs the service and how the data is managed.
howTo: Use the filters at the top to show or hide no-smoking zones, smoking areas and apartments
Tap a marker on the map to see its details
Select an area in the list to jump to its location
